title: ux design update just isn’t it..
body:
i have used this app religiously for years and it had been a great tracker for my productivity. i had mixed feelings ab the monthly sub news but glad i could keep my one-time sub alive. however, i most esp miss the favorites feature and how straightforward the ux used to be! 

this update makes me have to click so much more buttons to finish planting and i even have to wait through all the animations. i get the animations are pretty and all, but for a focus app, it’s a waste of time. i cant even view how much time in the day ive spent focusing anymore unless i check my actual forest. the favorites feature was also ironically my FAVORITE feature and it’s just gone, along with all of the favorites i had prepared in advance assigning trees per task. i really dont understand why this feature had to go???

besides all that, i do like the session title feature and how we have more options in the shop. visuals wise, i admit they also aren’t that bad. but honestly the things ive mentioned above really have been a bother to me as a regular user. 

my review is two stars and not one for my lingering love for the app, and im rating low in the hopes you can be able to notice. but i genuinely hope you can listen to your users seeing as there have been so many complaints everywhere and barely any movement. thank you.

title: It is buggy after the new UI overhaul
body:
The new UI overhaul has made the app significantly more frustrating to use. It feels like a major redesign was made without enough consideration for the existing user experience, and many things that used to be simple are now unintuitive and require additional steps.

On my end, the app is also extremely buggy. If I leave the app while a tree is growing, all of my apps become unlocked. Sometimes, when the timer finishes, the tree doesn't even get recorded. The app also randomly closes at times.

I really hope the team prioritizes stability and usability rather than continuing to add or change things unnecessarily. Forest was already a simple and effective productivity app, so the redesign feels like it has made the experience more complicated without adding much value. Please listen to the existing users and consider their feedback when making major UI changes.

title: Feedback on the New Update!
body:
I like the new update, the new UI is clean and the addition of the “I’ll spend my time on…” makes it feel more intentional whenever you plant a tree. 

But I’m writing this review because I miss when the main page displayed your total focus time. AND ESPECIALLY the circle that we can use to adjust the focus time. You guys need to bring that back as it’s super handy and we can visualize the tree better and its different levels depending on the duration. The circle presenting the tree has increased in size in this update, I suggest reducing the circumference a bit to accommodate the circle dial.

Also, I miss when we could adjust the tag/label, the tree, and the duration all in one small tab. Now you have to open individual tabs for each one, so three interfaces have to be used to adjust each one which I think is inconvenient. And it covers up the entire screen, size can be reduced.

tldr: new update is aesthetic, but we lost features that made the service convenient.

I started to care more about the numbers than actually learning or working, rather than putting in the work. And from this loss, I learnt that this is just an app. You can work 8 hours, forget to log it, and feel bad that you won’t see it. But you know you worked, and you even did it without incentive. That’s worth a lot more. You can always start over because that drive was and has always been in you methinks.

title: Great app for ADHD but i wish it had an alarm for completed focus times
body:
I give it 4 stars overall because it has helped with managing my productivity and inattention. It also keeps me motivated because focus time can lead to actual trees being planted and it makes simple things values- and advocacy-driven, which is a stronger motivation source for me than gamification, although the latter does help a lot also. I love seeing my forest at the end of each week. It is also very helpful that there is a timer mode and a set time mode and a switch to turn deep focus mode on and off because there are tasks that I need to switch apps like when I need to use the calculator app or check the calendar. 

I give it 4 stars because it is nearly perfect. I just wish it had the option to add a soothing alarm sound and congratulatory banner after each set focus time so I know when the time is up. One of my issues with ADHD is that hyperfocusing leads to obsession or lack of balance and it would be great to have a reminder at the end of 30 minutes or so to remind me to pause and check in with my energy. I can’t do this with the current app or ai just don’t know how? I’m new to this. Either way, I hope it can be a feature in the next update. And just the same, would definitely recommend the app. I think it is useful as is.

title: More Features.
body: Let me start first by saying that this app is beyond spectacular. It genuinely made a positive impact on how I managed my time efficiently, and productively. However, as a user I passionately believe that there are some needed features. These features include (1) syncing the plant mode between devices of the same account, and (2) allowing some apps to be exempt from the deep plant mode. The prior suggestion I just got from another review of the app, the latter I formed myself. I think we should be given the option to use 3rd party apps in deep focus mode that will not kill the plant. These apps are generally educational i.e. Notability, Goodnotes, Microsoft applications, et al. As a student using an iPad for primarily academic purposes, I truly believe these are necessary for the app to become better.

title: My best app purchase!
body:
By far my best app purchase. Highly recommend for those struggling to maintain focus on anything because of social media and their gadgets. I don’t usually review apps but this one totally deserves it. 

Basically the app lets you plant a virtual tree. Your tree dies if you use your gadget or open any other app. You get to track your gadget time too so you’re more aware of how much time you spend or waste (lol) on your phone. Really useful app!

Bonus: You get points for planting your virtual tree and unlocking achievements so that if you get 2,500 points you can plant a real tree!

title: With a Little Honesty, You can Improve Performance Awareness and Work Efficiency
body: When you plant and track hours here, you can't open other apps or your plant will die. Therefore, zero activity on the phone. But you can still visit facebook, instagram, and other distracting sites using your other gadgets. That's the setback. That's why I said, you have to be honest by not visiting other non-related sites in your other gadgets while you track hours using this app on your phone. If you do this, you can view from this app the trees and bushes you planted and label them according to the task you were handling during these hours. By looking at your activity page in the app, you will see the work you've accomplished and the number of hours or minutes you spent on them. Great app if you'll only be honest!
